name: Lorain
detailed_description:
How far are you willing to go to find the answers you seek? Modify your body? Yes! Fall into countless traps? Absolutely! Face hordes of lustful enemies and navigate complex mazes for just a single clue? Yes, yes, and yes again! Nothing can quench the thirst for knowledge of woman adventurer-scientist Lora!

Driven by an unstoppable desire to uncover the truth and harness the power of magical stones using technology, she dares to defy the ultimate taboo of her world! Her journey will be filled with numerous challenges that you'll have to overcome, and throughout her adventures, she will be guided by the unseen hand of an ancient scientist who once walked this very same path!

Will you be able to unlock all the secrets and collect every erotic scene?

This is a platformer where you can find yourself in some super spicy situations! But as you unlock new upgrades, you'll be able to turn the tables and have your way with anyone who captured you previously!

There are also multiple endings to experience! Will you save the world or bring it to total destruction?

Loads of Customization!

Dress Lora up in whatever panties and stockings you like the most!

Sex Scenes Galore!

21 sex scenes with enemies (where you can customize Lora's hair and outfit to match your desires)! There are also 2 full screen sex scenes!

Monster Girls?!

3 sex scenes for each of the 9 enemy monster girls!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
